run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with the mailing list CC'd
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with a custom --cc flag to add extra reviewers to the patch upload
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and appends the Google Test group to the CC list
summarize_main: summarize the main function that parses CLI args and invokes upload.py via os.execv
refactor_main: refactor the main function to use argparse instead of manual sys.argv parsing for CLI flags
